specification_compliance: No reader findings were listed, so there was nothing to verify. As a spot check I read addons/knowledge/frontend/clipsapp/usePagedClips.ts and useShelfData.ts at the pinned knowledge commit, because the head commit records the R-5 recheck of the clip refresh fix. A refresh keeps an unnamed card only when one page was re-asked or the card is being saved, and never when menuRemoved(id) is true (usePagedClips.ts:110-115). This matches I3: a card is not drawn again while its list is held. loadMore after a menu removal asks pages 1..pages+1 again and filters out goneIds (usePagedClips.ts:150-176). A page that answers after a revision bump is dropped (line 169). This matches I4: no skipping or repeating, and no id is drawn twice.
